master.name_zh: 甲状腺功能亢进症与甲状腺危象
master.definition_en: Overactivity of the thyroid gland resulting in overproduction of thyroid hormone and increased metabolic rate. Causes include diffuse hyperplasia of the thyroid gland (Graves' disease), single nodule in the thyroid gland, and thyroiditis. The symptoms are related to the increased metabolic rate and include weight loss, fatigue, heat intolerance, excessive sweating, diarrhea, tachycardia, insomnia, muscle weakness, and tremor.

mechanisms: Type I iodothyronine deiodinase (Type-I 5'-deiodinase) (DIOI) (Type 1 DI) (5DI) inhibitor

curated.name_zh: 甲状腺功能亢进症与甲状腺危象
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 普通甲亢为慢性高代谢性疾病，可逐步诱发甲亢性心脏病、房颤与心力衰竭；但当遭遇感染、手术、停药或创伤诱发“甲状腺危象（Thyroid Storm）”时，大量甲状腺激素释放入血，若未予抢救病死率高达80%-100%，即便经过现代ICU综合救治，其短期住院/90天病死率仍达8%-25%。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 常规甲亢可通过抗甲状腺药物（约40%-50%缓解）、放射性131I治疗或甲状腺次全/全切术实现临床控制甚至根治；甲状腺危象则须ICU级多药联合阻断激素合成、释放与外周转化并予糖皮质激素、支持与控心率。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO与GBD未单列甲亢/甲状腺危象全球独立死因总数；临床文献显示甲状腺危象约占住院甲毒症患者的1.48%，未治病死率80%-100%，积极治疗下14天、28天及90天病死率分别约为5.23%、6.59%和8.12%（综合住院/ICU报道8%-25%）

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 无独立全国年度死因统计；中国地区人群常规药品保障队列测算甲状腺危象年发病率约0.55/10万人年，病死风险集中于合并多器官功能衰竭及甲亢性心衰患者

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球碘充足地区显性甲亢患病率约0.2%-1.3%，Graves病占全部甲亢病例的60%-80%。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国31省TIDE全国调查（约8万人样本）显示成人显性甲亢患病率为0.78%（女性1.16%、男性0.64%），其中Graves病患病率为0.53%（PMC8194401）。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 甲状腺危象（Burch-Wartofsky评分≥45分）四联序贯急救：1) 立即口服/鼻饲大剂量丙硫氧嘧啶（PTU首剂500-1000 mg后250 mg q4h）阻断新激素合成及外周T4向T3转化；2) 服用PTU后严格间隔1小时再予复方碘溶液（Lugol液）抑制已合成激素释放；3) 静脉或口服普萘洛尔控制交感风暴与心室率（心衰者改用短效艾司洛尔）；4) 静脉注射氢化可的松100 mg q8h防相对肾上腺皮质功能不全，同时物理降温、补液并抗感染；顽固高热/昏迷可行血浆置换。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 针对Graves病及甲状腺相关眼病（TED）的精准靶向免疫治疗取得实质进展：FcRn抑制剂（Batoclimab、Efgartigimod）及靶向TSH受体的单克隆抗体/小分子拮抗剂（如K1-70）在2期试验中展示降低TRAb致病抗体水平潜力；2) 针对中重度活动性甲状腺眼病的IGF-1R抑制剂替妥尤单抗（Teprotumumab及国内同类生物制剂）推动多靶点个体化治疗。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 抗甲状腺药物停药后复发率仍高达40%-50%，且少数患者发生粒细胞缺乏与重度肝损伤；2) 甲状腺危象早期非特异性症状易误诊为脓毒症或精神躁狂导致延误；3) 基层131I后甲减长期随访依从性不足。

master.name_en: columnar cell hyperplasia of the breast
master.definition_en: A columnar cell lesion characterized by the presence of enlarged terminal ductal lobular units with dilated acini. The acini are lined by more than two layers of columnar epithelial cells. Prominent apical cytoplasmic snouts are present. Secretions are often present in the lumina of the dilated acini.

master.definition_en: A localized or multifocal mesothelioma arising from the peritoneum. It predominantly occurs in women. It is characterized by the formation of papillae, covered by a single layer of blunt mesothelial cells. Mitotic figures are not present. There is no evidence of severe cytologic atypia. It has a relatively favorable clinical outcome, compared to diffuse malignant mesothelioma.

master.definition_en: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 1A (CMT1A) is a type ofinherited neurological disorder that affects the peripheral nerves. Affected individuals experience weakness and wasting (atrophy) of the muscles of the lower legs beginning in adolescence; later they experience hand weakness and sensory loss. CMT1A is caused byhaving an extra copy (a duplication) of the PMP22 gene. It is inherited in an autosomal dominant manner. Treatment for this condition may include physical therapy ; occupational therapy ; braces and other orthopedic devices; orthopedic surgery;and pain medications.

master.definition_en: Any thrombocytopenia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the ETV6 gene that impair transcriptional repression and megakaryocyte maturation. It is characterized by lifelong thrombocytopenia, mild mucocutaneous bleeding, and variable red cell macrocytosis. Affected individuals have a significantly increased susceptibility to hematologic malignancies, including B‑cell ALL, myelodysplastic syndrome, CMML, and mixed‑phenotype acute leukemia, with onset ranging from childhood to adulthood. Functional studies show that pathogenic ETV6 variants disrupt DNA binding, alter nuclear localization, and exert dominant‑negative effects on hematopoiesis, providing a mechanistic basis for both the platelet phenotype and cancer predisposition.

master.definition_en: A rare spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia characterized by progressive joint contractures with premature degenerative joint disease, particularly in the knee, hip, and finger joints. Patients are of normal height and present with gait problems, joint pain, and enlarged joints with joint restriction and contractures. Radiological features include generalized platyspondyly, hypoplastic ilia, epiphyseal flattening with metaphyseal splaying of the tubular bones, and broad, elongated femoral necks with marked coxa valga. Histopathologic examination of cartilage shows PAS-positive cytoplasmic inclusion bodies in chondrocytes.

master.definition_en: Epignathus is a very rare and life threatening intraoral teratoma, usually arising from the maxilla, mandible, palate or base of skull and invading the cranium, nasopharynx or oral cavity. Epignathus is more commonly seen in females, and presents with various manifestations (depending on the tumor size) including obstructive polyhydramnios in the prenatal period and dyspnea, cyanosis, cough, difficulty in sucking and swallowing, and rarely vomiting (due to swallowing difficulties) postnatally. When large, they can lead to airway obstruction, asphyxia and death in the neonatal period.

master.definition_en: Elastoderma is a rare condition that affects the skin. People affected by elastoderma generally have increased laxity of skin covering a specific area of the body. Decreased recoil of the skin has also been reported. Although any part of the body can be affected, the skin of the neck and extremities (arms and legs, especially at the elbows and/or knees) are most commonly involved. The exact underlying cause is currently unknown; however, it generally occurs sporadically in people with no family history of the condition. There is no standard therapy available for elastoderma. Some cases have been treated with surgical excision (removal of affected skin), but hyperlaxity of skin often returns following the surgery.

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。

master.definition_en: A rare mosaic form of NF2-related schwannomatosis characterized by findings typical of NF2-related schwannomatosis, namely development of multiple benign nerve sheath tumors called schwannomas, particularly affecting the vestibular nerve. Mosaic form is caused by postzygotic pathogenic variants in NF2. In mosaic NF2-related schwannomatosis the allelic/tissue distribution of the pathogenic NF2 variant clearly suggests mosaicism. The phenotype can be milder than in NF2-related schwannomatosis.
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。
